calibration.axes: x right, y down, z forward
calibration.basis: Publisher recommends ROS default intrinsics without undistortion for pre-registered PNG depth. Depth is already rescaled and expressed in RGB optical coordinates; apply no extra correction or IR-to-RGB transform. This is the recommended approximation, not newly measured calibration.

generation: Every depth frame; explicit native CPU point-to-plane ICP on the same common voxel points, 20-neighbor target normal estimation and native default stopping thresholds. Same stages/support/gauge/IO as original point-to-point protocol. No motion prior, reference initialization, resets or reference tuning.
scope: freiburg1_xyz has already been scored and is exploratory. freiburg1_rpy is fixed as an untouched held-out sequence before its acquisition, generation or reference interpretation. Preserve all failures and coverage; do not retune after either result. Physical calibration and clock synchronization remain approximations, not independently measured.

acceptance.basis: Fixed engineering study thresholds before point-to-plane fitting; not publisher accuracy requirements or general production guarantees.
